description: Send a prompt to a local Ollama LLM (defaults to qwen3.8:27b; errors with a 'pull it first' message if the model isn't installed — no automatic substitution). Use for code review, second opinions, analysis, and AI-to-AI collaboration. Runs entirely locally — no API keys or network calls needed. Returns both human-readable text and a structured response (provider, model, sessionId, usage) via outputSchema.

model.description: DO NOT set this parameter unless the user explicitly requests a specific model. The tool uses qwen3.8:27b by default; if the model isn't pulled locally it returns a clear "ollama pull" error rather than substituting another model.

prompt.description: The question, code review request, or analysis task to send to Ollama

sessionId.description: Optional session ID for multi-turn conversations. Pass an empty string to start a new session (the response will include the new ID); pass a previous [Session ID: ...] value to continue the same chat. Conversation history is stored in /tmp/ask-llm-sessions/ for 24h.

name: ask-ollama
